The system must restrict standard travel paths to active lanes and prohibit driving on shoulders unless a permissive ODD exception is triggered—such as emergency evasive steering to avoid an imminent collision, executing a system fallback to achieve a minimal risk condition (MRC) on the shoulder, or when directed by an official traffic-control device.
